note: House League items, batch 3 of 4 (DC-H3): two balls, two pins and two Charms on existing rule pieces and physics profiles, written and landed together by E18-C10. Amounts, prices and physics scales are provisional (E24).

design.trigger: A plastic ball that barely hooks (spin response 0.5). +4 Mult for each roll thrown with it in a frame that ends as a spare.
design.pool: Shop Equipment slot; initial pool from Division 1.
design.presentation_needs: A plain plastic ball with a straight stripe; the stripe stays still in the roll, showing it is not hooking.

design.trigger: A slightly heavier ball (mass ×1.15). +2 Value for every pin down in the frame, for each roll thrown with it.
design.pool: Shop Equipment slot; initial pool from Division 1.
design.presentation_needs: A scuffed, dependable league ball; a tally mark for each pin it is credited with.

design.trigger: A dense hardwood pin (mass ×1.3): +20 Value when it falls, twice a Wood Pin's.
design.pool: Shop Equipment slot; initial pool from Division 1.
design.presentation_needs: Darker, tighter grain than Wood; it rocks and settles more slowly when hit.

design.trigger: +5 Value when it falls, and +$1 when it is still standing at the end of the frame.
design.pool: Shop Equipment slot; initial pool from Division 1.
design.presentation_needs: A dented tin pin; a coin rattles out of it when it survives the frame.

design.trigger: +8 Value for every spare converted since it was bought: each spare drops a pin in the jar after the frame banks, so it counts from the next frame. Selling it empties the jar.
design.pool: Shop Charm slot; initial pool from Division 1.
design.presentation_needs: A tip jar that fills with small pins; the count shows on the card and the new pin drops in after the bank.

design.trigger: +$1 after an open frame, paid with the frame's income. The open-frame counterpart of Tip Jar and Strike Fund.
design.pool: Shop Charm slot; initial pool from Division 1.
design.presentation_needs: A participation ribbon; it pins itself on after an open frame.
